steps.en: Successfully processed court records are counted
steps.id: Record court yang berhasil diproses dihitung
steps.why_en: There is no court update process whose records could be counted.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses update court yang recordnya bisa dihitung.

steps.en: Failed records and their errors are recorded
steps.why_en: No court update processing exists, so no errors are recorded.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses update court, jadi tidak ada error yang dicatat.

steps.why_en: No court update summary report exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada summary report update court.

steps.en: The report appears on the OIC dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard has no court update report feed.
steps.why_id: Dashboard tidak punya feed report update court.

steps.en: The OIC can open the report details
steps.why_en: There is no such report to open.
steps.why_id: Report semacam itu tidak ada untuk dibuka.
